tagline: Camera and microphone bridge for Xios
description:
**xios-media-server** runs **xios-mediad**, which gives Xios desktop apps access to the iPad's microphone (and optionally the camera) over local sockets.

You normally don't install this directly. The Xios desktop flavors pull it in.

changelog.notes:
- The microphone now turns on only while an app is connected to it, and turns off when the last one disconnects. The camera works the same way
- Before this, the microphone started at launch and stayed on with nothing listening, which also kept the iPad awake
